name: @clubhouse/features
description: Gherkin feature files and Cucumber-js step definitions for the ClubHouse acceptance tests

scripts.test: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db prisma db push --schema=../backend/prisma/schema.prisma && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db cucumber-js --import tsx --import "support/**/*.ts" --import "step_definitions/**/*.ts" "**/*.feature"
